caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional model of a small building labeled "BANK" on the front gable. The structure is painted in shades of yellow and brown, with a sloped red and maroon roof that has weathered and darkened areas. There are three tall, rectangular black chimneys, each topped with brown, ornate crown-like decorations. The building features a front porch with a red roof supported by thin columns, and decorative trim along the edges. The windows are arched and divided into multiple small panes, and the walls are adorned with geometric window and door designs. The entire model sits on a rectangular brown base with signs of wear and paint loss. The name "JOHN HALL" is written in uppercase brown lettering on the lower right of the composition, against a plain beige background.
title: Painted Tin Toy Bank
